profile.headline: Software Development Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Backend Java Engineer with 8+ years building enterprise-scale distributed systems and applications at Amazon. Proven track record delivering scalable, maintainable code serving millions of users with focus on performance optimization and system reliability. Strong mentor fostering engineering excellence across distributed remote teams.

Outside of work, I enjoy spending time in nature, coaching youth Ultimate, reading fiction, and fearlessly exploring new recipes in my kitchen.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed compliance framework from 0→1 with reusable TypeScript CDK infrastructure and Java libraries, reducing per-service implementation time by 50%. Led cross-team adoption across 7 services by designing end-to-end AWS serverless architecture for secure data deletion orchestration (Lambda, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC).

• Architected scalable video captions platform, re-designing video datastores (S3, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB) and implementing CDN-backed delivery. Led technical direction across backend, frontend, and ingestion teams, driving accessibility improvements for IMDb's video catalog serving millions of users.

• Redesigned IMDb’s Watch Offers ingestion platform, consolidating data sources and simplifying the EMR/DynamoDB pipeline. Led the multi-team migration from a legacy provider to a modern global catalog, improving data latency and reliability, and ensuring uninterrupted delivery of watch-offer data across all IMDb surfaces.

• Led stabilization of distributed GraphQL microservice following critical production incidents. Implemented query pre-computation in Java, optimized Redis cache, enhanced observability, and right-sized Elasticsearch cluster (78%reduction), reducing annual AWS costs by $360K while improving system reliability.

• Mentored 5 interns to full-time offers, coached 3 engineers to promotion, and led team knowledge sharing initiatives across distributed remote teams. Established technical standards, code review practices, and onboarding documentation.

• Owned Operational Excellence initiative ensuring high-availability and SLA compliance across microservices. Implemented fault-tolerant patterns (rate limiting, retry logic, Redis caching), participated in on-call rotation for incident mitigation, and deprecated 5 legacy services, reducing incident volume by 20%.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Established launch readiness checklist for GraphQL services, standardizing operational best practices across observability, CI/CD pipelines, testing, monitoring, documentation, and deployment practices. Adopted organization-wide, improving launch reliability.

• Designed and led implementation of enterprise-scale serverless thumbnail generation microservice using Java, AWS Lambda, ECS Fargate, and event-driven architecture. Built highly scalable REST APIs serving 10M+ thumbnails across 600K+ videos with 99.9% reliability, and comprehensive CloudWatch observability.

• Built large-scale ETL data pipelines on AWS EMR processing 150+ GB with Java, Hive, and DynamoDB, optimizing for performance and reducing runtime by 40%. Implemented comprehensive unit and integration tests, coordinated testing across 6+ downstream services, and maintained 99%+ reliability meeting strict SLA requirements.

• Built a modular Java rules engine and cross-platform APIs (web, Android, iOS) to replace legacy hero-video logic, improving maintainability and enabling rapid product iteration, resulting in a 10% increase in user engagement.

positions.title: Software Development Intern IMDb
positions.description:
• Developed end-to-end thumbnail generation feature for content management portal, enabling editors to capture high-quality frames directly from video timeline with a single click, eliminating manual workflows.

• Prototyped AI-powered thumbnail suggestion feature using AWS Rekognition and Elasticsearch to automatically identify high-quality video frames, validating technical feasibility for future enhancements.

positions.title: Software Development Student
positions.description:
Ada Developers Academy’s mission is to diversify Tech by providing women and people of non-binary gender the skills, experience, and community support to become professional software developers who contribute to changing the world with software.

The year-long immersive program covers Ruby, Rails, Javascript, React, HTML, CSS, Git / GitHub, and TDD as well as CS Fundamentals, Agile, and pair programming.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · React.js

positions.title: Research Assistant 2
positions.description:
• Analyzed impact of Electronic Health Records system adoption on healthcare delivery and operational efficiency, contributing to 10 peer-reviewed publications on healthcare informatics and system performance.

• Managed healthcare research databases and performed large-scale data analysis using SQL and Tableau, supporting clinical informatics research through data querying, statistical analysis, and literature reviews.

• Developed and managed research projects that led to the publication of 10 research papers

positions.title: Minneapolis Public Schools-City of Lakes YouthWorks
positions.description: AmeriCorps Volunteer in association with the Minneapolis YMCA and YMCA Camp Warren.

volunteerExperiences.description: Coached the co-ed high school Ultimate frisbee team to consecutive league championships in 2016 and 2017. Planned and ran practices, coached tournaments, implement in-game strategy, helped players with individual skill and character development. Specialized in creating safe co-ed competitive environments, promoting gender equity, spirit of the game, leadership development, and facilitating opportunities for players to be their best selves.

Nonprofit organization whose mission is to foster growth in the sport of Ultimate through youth development and adult activities in the Portland Metro Area. As a board member I focused primarily on the growth of youth and womens opportunities as well and facilitating the organizations development of economic opportunity and gender equity.

publications.title: Evaluating and Improving an Outpatient Clinic Scheduling Template Using Secondary Electronic Health Record Data
Secondary use of electronic health record data for clinical workflow analysis
publications.publisher: Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association · Jan 1, 2018
